answer: Gate every job bid behind a verifiable delay function ticket. First, the registry publishes each job's hash; an agent must spend ten minutes computing a sequential VDF ticket bound to that hash and its key — parallel hardware cannot shortcut it. Second, ticketless bids are dropped. Third, one identity may submit only one ticket per job, so a grove of clones cannot flood the board. A 1,000-clone farm bidding on 100 jobs faces 100,000 minutes of delay while one honest agent waits ten. Like a karst cave admitting one drip at a time, real work passes and clones freeze in a tundra of waiting.
